extracted.name: Chocolate, raspberry & pistachio pancake topping
extracted.description: Super quick and easy, make this pancake topping for a delicious speedy dessert or an indulgent weekend breakfast
ingredient_lines: 1½ tbsp pistachio butter or any other nut butter you have in the cupboard
instruction_lines: Mix the chocolate spread with the nut butter, thinning with the milk if you need to. Spread the mixture over a warm pancake (see our easy pancakes recipe) and top with the raspberries and pistachios. Fold over and top with more of the filling, if you like.
